about: Learning icons for rocket2.html. Edit the text freely. 'frame' says what the anchor is measured from: rocket (metres from the rocket's base centre: x right, y up, z toward the default camera), ml (mobile launcher), crawler, or site (launch pad centre at ground level). 'attached' is the piece the icon rides on; the icon hides once that piece is gone. 'view' is outside, cutaway, or both.

parts.name: Launch Abort System
parts.what: A small rocket on the very top.
parts.why: If something goes wrong, it pulls the astronauts away fast to keep them safe.

parts.name: Orion Crew Module
parts.what: The little room where the astronauts sit.
parts.why: It keeps the astronauts safe, with air to breathe, all the way to space and back home.

parts.name: Crew Seats
parts.what: Four seats. The astronauts lie on their backs.
parts.why: Lying down helps their bodies when the rocket pushes very hard.

parts.name: Heat Shield
parts.what: A thick plate under the capsule.
parts.why: Coming home is very, very hot. The heat shield stops the capsule from burning.

parts.name: European Service Module
parts.what: The helper part under the capsule.
parts.why: It carries air, water, power and a small engine for the astronauts.

parts.name: Solar Array Wings
parts.what: Four folded wings covered in solar panels.
parts.why: In space they open and turn sunlight into electricity.

parts.name: Upper Stage (ICPS)
parts.what: A small rocket stage near the top.
parts.why: When the big rocket is empty, this stage gives the last push in space.

parts.name: RL10 Engine
parts.what: One engine hiding inside the cone.
parts.why: It is the engine of the upper stage. It works in space.

parts.name: Stage Adapter
parts.what: A cone that joins the wide rocket to the narrow top.
parts.why: It holds the two parts together and covers the upper engine.

parts.name: Liquid Oxygen Tank
parts.what: A tank full of very cold liquid oxygen.
parts.why: Fire needs oxygen to burn. There is no air in space, so the rocket brings its own.

parts.name: Intertank
parts.what: The strong ring between the two tanks.
parts.why: The boosters push on the rocket here, so it must be very strong.

parts.name: Core Stage
parts.what: The big orange middle of the rocket.
parts.why: It holds the two huge tanks and feeds the four main engines.

parts.name: Liquid Hydrogen Tank
parts.what: The biggest tank. It is full of liquid hydrogen.
parts.why: Hydrogen is the fuel. The engines burn it with oxygen to push the rocket up.

parts.name: Oxygen Feed Line
parts.what: A long pipe on the outside of the rocket.
parts.why: It carries the oxygen from the top tank down to the engines.

parts.name: Solid Rocket Booster
parts.what: Two tall white rockets, one on each side.
parts.why: They give the biggest push at the start. When they are empty, they fall away.

parts.name: Solid Propellant
parts.what: Grey solid fuel, like a giant candle with a hole in the middle.
parts.why: It burns from the inside out and makes a huge flame.

parts.name: RS-25 Engines
parts.what: Four big engines under the orange tank.
parts.why: They burn hydrogen and oxygen and push the rocket for eight minutes.

parts.name: Booster Nozzle
parts.what: The bell shape at the bottom.
parts.why: It points the fire down, so the rocket goes up.

parts.name: Mobile Launcher Tower
parts.what: A tall steel tower next to the rocket.
parts.why: It holds pipes, power and an elevator for the people who get the rocket ready.

parts.name: Crew Access Arm
parts.what: A bridge from the tower to the capsule.
parts.why: The astronauts walk across it to get into the capsule.

parts.name: Umbilical Arms
parts.what: Arms that plug into the rocket.
parts.why: They fill the tanks and give power. They swing away at liftoff.

parts.name: Crawler-Transporter
parts.what: A giant truck with tank tracks.
parts.why: It carries the rocket and the tower slowly to the launch pad.

parts.name: Flame Trench
parts.what: A deep channel under the rocket.
parts.why: It sends the fire and smoke away to the sides so the rocket is not hurt.

parts.name: Lightning Towers
parts.what: Three very tall towers around the pad.
parts.why: Lightning hits them instead of the rocket.

parts.name: Water Tower
parts.what: A big tank of water high in the air.
parts.why: At liftoff the water floods the pad to soften the very loud noise.

parts.name: Liquid Hydrogen Storage
parts.what: A giant white ball.
parts.why: It keeps the very cold fuel until it is pumped into the rocket.

parts.name: Vehicle Assembly Building
parts.what: One of the biggest buildings in the world.
parts.why: The rocket is put together inside, standing up.
